result.reason: The operative language substantially reaches the preferred position: the cap is mutual, based on the greater of 12 months’ paid/payable fees and USD 1,000,000; all specified claims are uncapped; and Corio’s fee obligations are outside the cap. The indirect/consequential-damages exclusion is mutual. However, the lookback was unnecessarily changed to the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim itself, and the malformed duplicated paragraph was left intact. The consequential-damages exception also still refers only to Section 8 rather than using the new Excluded Claims concept; while the playbook expressly requires those claims to be uncapped rather than necessarily exempt from the damages waiver, this creates avoidable inconsistency. These defects reduce minimality and drafting quality, though unrelated commercial intent is preserved.
